title: Copilot Studio: block sharing of agents that embed maker credentials
summary: The credential-safety behaviour, default, licensing and documented control paths are supported. Hold because the separate Managed Environments sharing-limits control omits Microsoft's qualification that it only applies to agents requiring authentication; administrators could otherwise rely on it for agents it does not govern. The cited pages opened successfully, so the pre-check's rate-limit errors do not establish broken links.
